item.title: Federal authorities investigate cause of deadly plane crash in Florida
item.description: Nine people were killed Sunday when a Learjet crashed in South Florida. Federal authorities are investigating the cause of the crash that occurred during bad weather.

item.title: New restrictions at Texas Tech are changing what professors can teach
item.description: The rules have led to changes in course materials, prompted accusations of censorship and fueled pushback from faculty and students, including faculty departures, student protests and a federal lawsuit.

item.title: 'Messy,' 'divided' and 'scary': swing voters rate the country ahead of Election Day
item.description: One last check in with the Swing Shift voters before Election Day. All of them voted for President Trump. Now, they're rating his presidency and deciding who to support when he's not on the ballot.

item.title: Chicago entrepreneur turns empty downtown office space into vertical gardens
item.description: The pandemic changed how, and where, the world works, but the empty office space left behind is a big drain on the owners of all that unused commercial real estate. But one entrepreneur is starting to plant the seeds of a partial solution to this lingering problem.

item.description: The U.S. has become more politically polarized, but research shows people overestimate their differences and there is 'messy middle' majority of Americans who share overlapping political views.

item.title: 9 dead as jet nosedives and erupts into fireball near busy roadway in South Florida
item.description: U.S. Transportation Secretary Duffy says all nine people died aboard a business jet that crashed into a Florida neighborhood. The aircraft departed from Austin, Texas, and was headed to the Bahamas.
